articles.title: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Water Temple Walkthrough
articles.summary: The Water Temple of Ocarina of Time in the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild is a more involved dungeon compared to the original, with distinct and memorable rooms, but still requiring skill and strategy to navigate. To enter the temple, players must wear the Zora Tunic, which can be obtained by freeing King Zora from his ice block in Zora Domain, and then obtain the Iron Boots from the Ice Cavern. Once inside, players must remove their boots and float to the top of the main hall, where they must slay a Blue Tektite and equip the Iron Boots before descending to the first floor. The temple's water level can be lowered by playing Zelda's Lullaby on a specific platform, and players must be careful to note the correct water level for each spot.
